root_cause_label: Missing Completion Signal After Task Success
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent successfully completed all technical requirements (key generation, certificate creation, PEM file, verification.txt, working check_cert.py) but never issued a finish() completion signal, so the benchmark harness recorded a failure despite the environment being fully in the correct state.
t_err_evidence: Step 17 is the final action (running python3 /app/check_cert.py successfully, seeing 'Certificate verification successful'), after which the agent stops without ever calling finish() or emitting any completion signal to the benchmark harness.
t_commit_evidence: After step 17 (the last step), there are no more agent actions and no finish() was issued at any point; the failing outcome is locked in as the trajectory ends.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacks awareness that the OpenHands/benchmark framework requires an explicit finish() or task_done() call to register task completion; it treats a successful terminal command output as sufficient evidence of completion and simply stops.
